confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Central Vietnam pricing, with no live listings or booking pages checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than hotel and hostel anchors, which vary more by season and location. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the local beer relationship because direct knowledge is weaker. FX observation is the RBA homepage table for 2026-10-15 as surfaced in search results, cross-checked against market mid-rates of about 0.6956 on that date; it was not verified directly against the RBA statistical table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other mid-sized Vietnamese tourist cities, mainly Da Nang and Hoi An, adjusted slightly downward for Hue, which is generally a little cheaper than those, and against the general Vietnam domestic price structure for local restaurants and cafés.
